findings.rationale: Folded: W2a and W2e now each own the watcher change that reads their file into assemble({decision}) / assemble({compare}); W3a depends on them.

Folded: planned for non-campaign modes falls back to the session task list (W1d) and the row states it; depth-0 proxy decisions get guidance row W2g (eval first); until then the band labels the count as engine-only.
Folded: the watcher publishes a sources manifest (which writers are installed and enabled); readers render 來源未接 only when the writer is absent, and the current empty-state text when it is wired.
Folded: W3a deps add W1b, W1c, W1g, W1i; W2c no longer depends on W1c; W2a dep on W1e removed (ordering only).

Folded: shared-file table for wave 1 (runs-watch.js: W1a only; render-review-page.js: W1a buildPhase/watcher vs W1i text paths; hooks.json/hook-classes: W1c, W1de); no row bumps version or edits CHANGELOG; landing integrates in a fixed order with mechanical conflict resolution.

Folded: W2a split into W2a-m (helper script, mechanism) and W2a-g (skill step, guidance, eval); W2c starts with a probe and is classified after it; W1b must name a firing trigger or ship the writer with its trigger as guidance; W1f is mechanism only because session-mode set mints the root (allowed by §2.7) and rails only propagate.

Folded: W4 gate becomes a scripted scenario per mode incl. /l6 and ceo-agent without /lN, with per-cell pass/fail; forced triggers for 要你決定 (permission prompt), 疑似卡住 (stalled dispatch), 完成待驗收 (fixture campaign to terminal); cells whose writer is a pending guidance row must show 來源未接 and that is the pass condition.

Folded: each new hook names its knob, hook-classes entry, inventory count, measured per-call latency; matchers are exact tool names, never Task/Agent; W1c probes flock -n in the foreground before any spawn.

Folded: schemas for session-tasks/1, attention/1, decision/1, decisions sidecar and the task-status bundle; per-file lock + atomic rename for RMW writers; null-vs-0 stated; new assemble inputs do not extend runs-live/1 (sidecars only).

Folded: watcher liveness also counts recent tasks/attention files of the project; UserPromptSubmit re-ensures with a foreground flock probe; autostart only in opted-in repos (autopilot config, marker, or knob=1); idle-exit handles cleanup.
Folded: W0b answered (TaskCreated/TaskCompleted + PostToolUse TaskUpdate; tools gated by CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS for sonnet/opus); fallback: absent tasks file shows 任務工具未開 with the env hint.

Folded: W1a binds by the in-file root_run_id and an explicit ordering key, unbound on mismatch; awaiting_disposition maps to 等待處置 and never to 要你決定. Partly refuted: session-mode set minting a job root is what §2.7 prescribes for dev-flow; only rails must never mint.

Folded: one release rule: v2.37.0 = all mechanism rows + W3a + W4 gate; guidance rows follow as PATCH after eval, showing 來源未接 meanwhile (owner ruling: fields stay, nothing removed); W1d/W1e are post-spike mechanism rows; negative controls required for every new writer (stale file, file left after end signal, wrong-root file).
